Please note that Figure 43, is a general description for all stats as defined in 
Table 6 Functional Requirements. To briefly overview this section, reset rank 
changed, marks all entries as viewed by the user, if that statistics rank has 
changed. Streak increments, only after 23 hours have passed. Lessons 
completed, flawless, speed run, and revised lessons, increment upon each call, 
whereas total gems increments by the gems attribute within the request body.
